get_firmware.help: Firmware version: the reply holds major and minor.

get_serial.help: Serial number, ASCII padded with zeros.

get_mode.help: Device mode in the first reply byte: 00 hardware, 03 driver.

set_mode.help: Switches the device mode and reloads profile 0 from the startup slot. Mode 01 reboots into the bootloader.

set_led.help: Turns an indicator on or off; the M indicator obeys only in driver mode.

set_led_blink.help: Makes an indicator blink until the next set_led.

list_profiles.help: Flash slots in use: the reply holds their count, then the slot numbers.

get_active_profile.help: The slot the keyboard starts with.

create_profile.help: Lists a slot; its page keeps what it held before.

delete_profile.help: Unlists a slot. Activate another first if it is the active one.

activate_profile.help: Makes the slot the startup one, reloads profile 0 from it and erases the settings page.

args: u16 BE, bytes of the name

get_profile_name.help: Reads a slot's name: the reply repeats the header, then UTF-16 BE.

set_key_assignment.help: Writes one key's press and release points and its function on a layer. Thresholds map 00..FF onto 1.5..3.6 mm.

get_key_assignment.help: Reads one key's press and release points and its function on a layer.

macro_allocate.help: Reserves flash for a macro body.

macro_write.help: Writes a chunk of a macro body; the firmware writes the flash about 100 ms later.

macro_delete.help: Removes a macro body from the flash.

macro_stats.help: Macro store: count u16, 2 bytes, free u32, free u32.

get_effect.help: Reads the effect a store holds.

set_frame.help: Per-key colors of one row for the custom effect.

get_brightness.help: Reads the brightness a store holds.
